applications.leaf-cursor: Historical experiment with a modified SQLite source and a private cursor write. Its results are excluded from production claims.
applications.stock-sqlite: Eligible production build, with the same reader and unchanged SQLite as PR #403.

method: Compare the original organizer-scored executable to the production stock-SQLite executable at the same loads on the 524,288-bucket/one-core fixture. The production executable changes the TCP reactor and JSON renderer and shares the original reader and unmodified SQLite. Each stock score includes a full ramp and five-minute hold, after a fresh process restart, database copy and random user schedules. Historical private-cursor experiments are explicitly labeled.
